name: mm2-kbench-final
command: bash kbench/mm_ab.sh kbench_ref,kbench_mm2 --dtypes q4k --shapes qkv,z,out,gate,down,dhead,head --threads 4 --batch 1,2,3,4,5,7,16,64 && bash kbench/mm_ab.sh kbench_ref,kbench_mm2 --dtypes q8 --shapes qkv,gate,down,head --threads 4 --batch 1,4,5,8,64
